referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A blue-hour Westminster photograph frames a short serif assurance statement, practical audience routes and a gold consultation action. Small light wordmark and thin audience/service links overlay the opening; a persistent action is reserved for contact. Classic serif display over concise sans service copy; numbered editorial chapter labels and small trust details. The page sequence runs from city landmark promise to trust detail ribbon to three-audience photo gateway toward team, consultation form, footer. Three real-life audience portraits follow the hero; team portraits, icons and restrained case/proof cards appear much later. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
